source_refs.note: Book p. 231: 12.3.2 Criterion for Existence of Limit of a Function (limit exists iff left and right hand limits are equal) and Example 10 (a three-piece function at x = 2 and x = 4).

items.title: 12.3.2 Criterion for Existence of Limit of a Function (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein aap ne left hand aur right hand limits alag alag nikaalna seekha. Ab sawal yeh hai: in dono ka asal limit \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) se kya rishta hai? Is sabaq mein yahi kasauti (criterion, yani parakhne ka usool) seekhenge jis se pata chalta hai ke limit exist karti hai ya nahin.

blocks.latex: \begin{gathered}\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L \text{ if and only if} \\ \lim_{x \to c^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c^{+}} f(x) = L\end{gathered}
blocks.text_alt: limit of f of x as x tends to c equals L if and only if the left hand limit and the right hand limit at c are both equal to L

blocks.text: Asaan alfaaz mein: \(c\) par \(f(x)\) ki limit tab aur sirf tab exist karti hai (aur \(L\) ke barabar hoti hai) jab left hand limit aur right hand limit dono exist karein aur dono \(L\) ke barabar hon.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
"If and only if" (tab aur sirf tab) ka matlab hai ke baat dono taraf chalti hai:
1. Agar dono one-sided limits exist karein aur barabar hon (\(L\)), to \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x)\) exist karti hai aur \(L\) ke barabar hai.
2. Aur ulta bhi: agar \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L\) hai to dono one-sided limits bhi \(L\) hi hongi.
Is liye limit do soorton mein exist nahin karti: jab dono one-sided limits mukhtalif hon (graph \(c\) par chhalaang lagata hai), ya jab un mein se koi ek exist hi na kare.
Kyun? Limit ek hi number hota hai jis ki taraf \(f(x)\) har taraf se barhta hai. Agar baayen taraf 3 ki taraf ja rahi hai aur daayen taraf 4 ki taraf, to koi ek number hai hi nahin jise hum "limit" keh sakein. Jaise do raaste ek chauraahe par milne chahiye; agar ek raasta ooper pul par khatam ho aur doosra neeche, to woh milte hi nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Piecewise function ke jorr (joining point) \(c\) par tareeqa:
1. \(x < c\) wala formula le kar left hand limit nikaalein.
2. \(x > c\) wala formula le kar right hand limit nikaalein.
3. Muqabla karein: barabar hon to limit exist karti hai (aur wahi common value hai); mukhtalif hon to limit exist nahin karti.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Example 10 ka function parhne se pehle yeh samajh lijiye ke piecewise function ki har line kaise parhi jati hai. "\(2x + 1\) if \(0 \le x \le 2\)" ka matlab hai: jab \(x\) zero se le kar 2 tak ho (2 samet), to \(f(x)\) ki value \(2x + 1\) se nikaalo. "\(7 - x\) if \(2 < x < 4\)" ka matlab: 2 aur 4 ke darmiyan (dono ko chhor kar) \(7 - x\) use karo. Har \(x\) ke liye sirf ek line lagti hai. Sab se pehle hamesha yeh dekhiye ke jis \(x\) ki baat ho rahi hai woh kis line ki shart (condition) poori karta hai; yahi aadhi jeet hai.

blocks.title: Example 10
blocks.problem:
Determine whether \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) and \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x)\) exist, when
\[f(x) = \begin{cases} 2x + 1 & \text{if } 0 \le x \le 2 \\ 7 - x & \text{if } 2 < x < 4 \\ x & \text{if } 4 \le x \le 6 \end{cases}\]
steps:
Given: upar diya hua teen tukdon wala function \(f\), jo \(0 \le x \le 6\) ke liye defined hai.
To find: kya \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) aur \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x)\) exist karti hain.
Method: sab se pehle dekhiye ke \(x = 2\) aur \(x = 4\) woh points hain jahan formula badalta hai. Aise points par hamesha dono taraf ki limits alag nikaalte hain, aur phir criterion lagate hain: limit sirf tab exist karegi jab dono barabar hon.

(i) Step 1: \(x = 2\) par left hand limit
\(x\), 2 ke qareeb aur 2 se chhota ho to \(f(x) = 2x + 1\).
\[\lim_{x \to 2^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 2^{-}} (2x + 1)\]
\[= 2(2) + 1 = 4 + 1 = 5\]
Kyun: 2 ke baayen taraf (\(0 \le x < 2\)) pehla formula lagta hai. \(2x + 1\) ek polynomial hai, aur polynomial ki limit seedha \(x\) ki jagah number rakhne (substitution) se mil jati hai.

(i) Step 2: \(x = 2\) par right hand limit
\(x\), 2 ke qareeb aur 2 se bara ho to \(f(x) = 7 - x\).
\[\lim_{x \to 2^{+}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 2^{+}} (7 - x)\]
\[= 7 - 2 = 5\]
Kyun: 2 ke daayen taraf (\(2 < x < 4\)) doosra formula lagta hai. Dhyan dein: pehle formula mein "\(\le 2\)" likha hai, is liye woh sirf left side aur khud 2 ke liye hai, right side ke liye nahin.

(i) Step 3: Muqabla
\[\lim_{x \to 2^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 2^{+}} f(x) = 5\]
\[\Rightarrow \lim_{x \to 2} f(x) \text{ exists and } = 5\]
Kyun: 12.3.2 ki kasauti kehti hai ke jab dono one-sided limits barabar hon to limit exist karti hai aur wahi value rakhti hai. Yahan graph ke dono hisse 2 par height 5 par mil jate hain.

(ii) Step 4: \(x = 4\) par left hand limit
\(x\), 4 ke qareeb aur 4 se chhota ho to \(f(x) = 7 - x\).
\[\lim_{x \to 4^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 4^{-}} (7 - x)\]
\[= 7 - 4 = 3\]
Kyun: 4 ke baayen taraf (\(2 < x < 4\)) doosra formula lagta hai.

(ii) Step 5: \(x = 4\) par right hand limit
\(x\), 4 ke qareeb aur 4 se bara ho to \(f(x) = x\).
\[\lim_{x \to 4^{+}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 4^{+}} x = 4\]
Kyun: 4 ke daayen taraf (\(4 \le x \le 6\)) teesra formula lagta hai, jo bas \(f(x) = x\) hai.

(ii) Step 6: Muqabla
\[\lim_{x \to 4^{-}} f(x) = 3\]
\[\lim_{x \to 4^{+}} f(x) = 4\]
\[3 \ne 4\]
Is liye \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x)\) exist nahin karti.
Kyun: dono taraf mukhtalif numbers ki taraf ja rahi hain, is liye koi ek limit nahin. Graph 4 par height 3 se seedha height 4 par chhalaang lagata hai.

Tasdeeq: points ke bilkul qareeb values rakh kar dekhte hain.
\[f(1.99) = 4.98,\quad f(2.01) = 4.99\]
Dono 5 ke qareeb hain, jaisa humne nikaala.
\[f(3.99) = 3.01,\quad f(4.01) = 4.01\]
Left par values 3 ke paas, right par 4 ke paas rehti hain; yani 4 par waqai jump hai.
blocks.answer: \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) exist karti hai aur 5 ke barabar hai; \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x)\) exist nahin karti, kyun ke left hand limit 3 aur right hand limit 4 hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Ek dilchasp baat note kijiye: \(f(4) = 4\) defined hai (teesre formula se), phir bhi \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x)\) exist nahin karti. Yani kisi point par function ki value aur us point par limit do alag sawal hain. Agle sabaq 12.3.3 mein continuity bilkul inhi do cheezon ka muqabla karti hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh kitab ka sawal nahin, practice ke liye hai. Agar \(f(x) = 5x + 3\) jab \(x \le 1\) aur \(f(x) = 9 - x\) jab \(x > 1\), to kya \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) exist karti hai?
Soch: left se \(5(1) + 3 = 8\); right se \(9 - 1 = 8\). Dono barabar, is liye limit exist karti hai aur 8 hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 10 mein agar teesra tukda \(x\) ki jagah \(x - 1\) hota (\(4 \le x \le 6\)), to kya \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x)\) exist karti? (Jawab: right hand limit \(4 - 1 = 3\) ho jati, jo left hand limit 3 ke barabar hai; to haan, limit 3 hoti.)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Jawab hamesha teen hisson mein likhiye: LHL, RHL, aur muqabla. Aakhir mein saaf jumla likhiye: "limit exists and equals 5" ya "limit does not exist". Sirf numbers likh kar chhor dena poore marks nahin dilata.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L\) tab aur sirf tab jab \(\lim_{x \to c^{-}} f(x) = \lim_{x \to c^{+}} f(x) = L\).
2. One-sided limits mukhtalif hon to limit exist nahin karti.
3. Piecewise function mein har us point par limit check karein jahan formula badalta hai, aur har side par sahi tukda use karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sirf ek taraf dekh kar ruk jana: \(\lim_{x \to 4^{-}} f(x) = 3\) nikaal kar \(\lim_{x \to 4} f(x) = 3\) likh dena. Dono taraf zaroori hain.
2. "=" wale tukde ko dono taraf use karna: \(x = 4\) par teesra tukda (\(4 \le x\)) sirf right side ke liye hai.
3. Yeh samajhna ke \(f(c)\) defined hai to limit bhi zaroor exist karti hai. Aisa nahin hai, Example 10 ka \(x = 4\) dekh lijiye.
